title: "Stop Making Excuses—Your Soul is at Risk!" 🔥
paragraphs: "Stop Making Excuses—Your Soul is at Risk!" 🔥

🔥 HOW MANY PEOPLE ARE IN HELL RIGHT NOW… BECAUSE THEY MADE EXCUSES?
🚨 "I’ll repent later." But later never came.
🚨 "I’m not ready to give up my sin." But sin never gave up on them.
🚨 "God understands my heart." Yes, and that’s why judgment is coming!

💀 HELL IS FULL OF PEOPLE WHO THOUGHT THEY HAD MORE TIME.
😨 What excuse is keeping YOU from fully surrendering to Jesus?
📖 "It is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment." (Hebrews 9:27)
🔥 NO MORE EXCUSES—CHOOSE JESUS NOW!

🔥 1. EXCUSES WILL LEAD YOU TO ETERNAL REGRET
📖 "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord’… but I will declare, ‘I NEVER KNEW YOU; depart from Me!’" (Matthew 7:22-23)
🚨 Excuses are the #1 reason people will MISS HEAVEN.
🔥 THE MOST COMMON EXCUSES THAT KEEP PEOPLE FROM SALVATION:

❌ "I’m not ready to follow Jesus yet."
📖 Truth: You are NOT promised tomorrow!
📖 "You do not know what tomorrow will bring." (James 4:14)

❌ "I’ll get serious about God later."
📖 Truth: Later may NEVER come!
📖 "Seek the Lord while He may be found." (Isaiah 55:6)

❌ "I’m a good person, so I’ll be fine."
📖 Truth: Good works will NOT save you—ONLY Jesus can!
📖 "All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God." (Romans 3:23)

❌ "God knows my heart."
📖 Truth: Yes, He does—and that should TERRIFY you!
📖 "The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately sick." (Jeremiah 17:9)
🔥 WHICH OF THESE EXCUSES HAVE YOU MADE? IT’S TIME TO STOP!
🚨 THE LONGER YOU WAIT, THE HARDER YOUR HEART BECOMES!

🔥 2. THE DEVIL WANTS YOU TO PROCRASTINATE UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE
📖 "Now is the day of salvation!" (2 Corinthians 6:2)
🚨 Satan’s greatest trick? Making you believe you have "plenty of time."

🔥 HELL WILL BE FULL OF PEOPLE WHO THOUGHT THEY HAD MORE TIME.
💀 The scariest part? They believed in Jesus… but they never truly FOLLOWED Him.
📖 "Behold, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake." (Revelation 16:15)
🚨 JESUS COULD RETURN AT ANY MOMENT—ARE YOU READY?

🔥 3. HOW TO STOP MAKING EXCUSES AND GET RIGHT WITH GOD TODAY
📖 "Choose this day whom you will serve." (Joshua 24:15)
🚀 Here’s how to fully surrender to Jesus and remove ALL excuses:

✅ 1. STOP WAITING—MAKE JESUS YOUR #1 PRIORITY.
📖 "Seek first the kingdom of God." (Matthew 6:33)

✅ 2. REPENT AND TURN FROM SIN—NO MORE DELAYS!
📖 "Unless you repent, you will all likewise perish." (Luke 13:3)

✅ 3. PRAY AND READ GOD’S WORD DAILY—NOT JUST ON SUNDAYS.
📖 "Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path." (Psalm 119:105)

✅ 4. STOP COMPROMISING—CHOOSE JESUS OVER EVERYTHING ELSE.
📖 "If anyone wishes to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross DAILY." (Luke 9:23)
🔥 TODAY is the day of salvation—YOU ARE NOT PROMISED TOMORROW!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if you refuse to make excuses for sin!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you are choosing Jesus TODAY!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to wake up others before it’s too late!

🔥 THE NO EXCUSES CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—have you been making excuses for your faith?
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this urgent wake-up call!

📢 🚨 WARNING: The enemy does NOT want you to share this.
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 22, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I repent for any excuses I have made that kept me from fully following You. I don’t want to wait another second—I choose Jesus TODAY. Lord, remove every distraction, every delay, and every sin that has kept me from seeking You first. Fill me with boldness, strength, and a hunger for Your presence. Help me to live for You with NO MORE EXCUSES. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
